title: claude-harness configuration
description: Declares what verification means for this project. Belongs at the repository root, in version control.

commands.description: The project's verification commands. The only required section.

verify.description: The closing gate: what the project runs when it wants to know the tree is healthy.

verifyFast.description: Runs at the end of every turn, so it must be fast. Falls back to `verify` when unset.

editCheck.description: Runs the moment a source file is written, debounced. Must be faster than verifyFast. Null (the default) means the edit gate never runs.

verifyTimeoutMs.description: How long verify-gate waits for verifyFast before standing aside.

include.description: Repo-relative globs that count as source. Replaces the default list; does not extend it.

patterns.description: Extra command-to-kind mappings, checked before the builtin catalog.

kind.description: Ledger event kind, e.g. test, lint, typecheck.

useBuiltins.description: Set false to recognise only your own patterns plus those derived from `commands`.

maxSameFailure.description: Attempts against one unchanged failure signature before the loop halts.

editCheck.description: Runs commands.editCheck right after a source edit. Early warning, never the boundary — every skip can only defer a check, because verify-gate still runs at the end of the turn.

graceMs.description: Wait this long, then stand down if a newer edit arrived. Parallel tool calls in one message otherwise check a half-applied refactor.

windowMs.description: Skip if the last run was GREEN and more recent than this. A red result is never suppressed.

paths.description: Which files it applies to. Empty means whatever `source` says is source.

readOnlyAgents.description: Agents exempt from the repair loop because they cannot write source.

preflight.description: Entry conditions, checked before a task-loop run spends an iteration.

cleanTree.description: Refuse to start on a dirty tree, so this run's diff can be told apart from what was already there. Entry only, never re-checked mid-run. Untracked files are ignored deliberately.

treeGreen.description: Refuse to start on a red tree, by running commands.verifyFast. Refuse, do not repair — a run that begins by fixing what it did not cause cannot say which part of its diff is its own work.

reachable.description: URLs the work depends on. `${env:NAME}` resolves from the environment, and a target resolving to nothing is reported as UNSET rather than unreachable. Any HTTP response counts as reachable.

commands.description: Commands that must exit 0 before the loop starts, and between iterations.

maxConsecutiveFailures.description: Consecutive failures of the between-iteration checks before the run halts. One flaky response is not evidence a dependency is down.
